The additional maps all have their own personality (like Ticket to Ride, if you want to think of it that way). In my opinion, whoever buys this is in for a treat. Well worth the asking price.

If you’ve regretted missing multiple kickstarters for Tanares and Arena the Contest – this listing is for you! I’ve just found that I don’t have the time to play this game as I had hoped to.
This listing includes everything for Arena the Contest, Tanares Adventures, Ultimate Edition Update, and Tanares RPG – except for the Phoenix add on.
Everything has been organized into the Tanares Ultimate Boxes according to the YouTube tutorial provided online.
Everything from the original Arena the Contest, Dragon Collection and Legendary boxes have been painted to a high-quality standard and have been featured in the Tanares Adventures Group on Facebook.
This listing includes: • Arena the Contest (fully painted – organized in Tanares Ultimate boxes) • Arena the Contest Legendary Box (fully painted – organized in Tanares Ultimate boxes) • Dragon Collection (fully painted) • Arena the Contest – Plastic Tokens • Arena – Bonus 20-sided dice and pouch • Tanares Adventures (updated version) • Tanares Ultimate Boxes (already fully organized) • Additional Game Boards (for both Arena and Tanares) • Madness Box • Elder Dragon • Terrasque • Golden Dragon • Silver Dragon (new in shrink) • Penumbral Pack (in Tanares Ultimate Boxes) • Medusa Hero Pack (in Tanares Ultimate Boxes) • Tanares RPG (Campaign Sourcebook, Player’s Guide, Adventures in the Realms of Madness, and Player Screen) (new in shrink) • Tanares RPG – GM-Less Pack (new in shrink) • 4 Player Dashboards | 32 Plastic Skill Tokens (new in shrink) • Tanares RPG - Bonus Maps • All Heroes Miniatures • All Villains Miniatures • All 3D Terrain

Item: Arcadia Quest Bundle Condition: New / Like New Price: $250
+remove+ Sales closed to prepare for the convention
Description Many are the reasons for which I purchased this game. The game looks fun. The miniatures look awesome. The miniatures would be excellent to paint. It has dragons. But few are the gaming sessions (okay, not few, but zero) where this game has hit the table. So, here's a bundle at what I think is a quite reasonable price. Included are: [thing=155068][/thing] [thing=179803][/thing] [thing=189273][/thing] [thing=156089][/thing] [thing=188699][/thing] [thing=233917][/thing] [thing=188447][/thing] [thing=189197][/thing] [thing=189455][/thing] [thing=348794][/thing]
And to round things out [thing=181524][/thing] I am pretty sure the Masmorra is the KS deluxe or whatever the right terms are, because there are extra dice and plastic tokens and stuff. I think I have the KS edition of Whole Lotta Lava or Inferno too, but I don't remember.
If you're travelling in, and you're interested in this, bring a box or a big suitcase. It's a lot of stuff. If you are travelling in and you live somewhere between Dallas and Denver I travel there frequently and can deliver. At the moment I am writing this listing based off of a picture on my phone. Again, if you are interested and have questions about anything specific that might be included, let me know and I will dig everything out and check for you.

item.body:
[B]Version:[/B] English edition (1995) [B]Language:[/B] English [B]Condition:[/B] Acceptable - [I]Overall adequate - Second owner, Contents sorted and bagged, missing 6 large white dice, game pads partially used
Includes: Citadel Miniatures Painting Guide - 0705 The Games Workshop: World of Hobby Games - 0717 The Tower of Hazuk - Printed WD 192 - Advertised the release of the ‘Witch Hunter’ warrior pack. "Into the Depths" article: adding yet more variety through dungeon design. Also included two new Board Sections (Collapsed Passage, Into the Dark/Spiral Staircase and Dead End).
WD 197 – "Lost Kingdoms" article: included the events Snake Pit, Alarm, Shifting Sands, Sliding Wall
Condition: Cardboard components - Like New, no scuffs or wear, cards look unused with no edge wear, one tile has a small dent in the corner, Missing Dwarf warrior counter
Box - Adequate - 2 corners split, some tape on box, significant shelf wear
Miniatures / Doorways - Some painted, Some still on sprues, Missing half of the miniatures

item.comment: Which version / box do you have? Is this the smaller square sized box, or the earlier "tombstone" sized box? I assume both the game and the expansion are mixed together in the same box? Thanks! :)

[q="drathbun"]Which version / box do you have? Is this the smaller square sized box, or the earlier "tombstone" sized box? I assume both the game and the expansion are mixed together in the same box? Thanks! :)[/q] It's the square box but definitely not small, it's like Star Wars Rebellion sized and yes all in the same box.

My understanding is that the original box was about the size of two Ticket to Ride boxes put side by side. 🙂 The first printing / edition of the game used that to their advantage so some of the parts you put together for the terrain could be bigger. When they reprinted it with the standard square box they had to break some of the parts up. That's why I was asking which size (shape) box you had. Thanks for confirming!

Fun Fact: I will be the Silent for Halloween and there is a very real possibility that I will be in costume at the VFM event (and my girl friend might also go as the Watcher).

Item: Toxic City Mall Extra Zombies Condition: Like New Price: $5 or free with any other Zombicide purchase
+sold+ for $5 to [user=Untgimp] Will be free if a later Zombicide purchase is added.
[-]Description This is not a listing for the game. In my quest of several years back to acquire all things Zombicide, I somewhere picked up an extra tray of zombie figures. Written on the box is a note about these figures going to Toxic City Mall. The tray holds 31 minis. 28 are smaller and 3 are larger. The colors are brown, gray and toxic green, of course. The image I have selected showed both the main character minis and the zombie minis; this tray [b]only[/b] includes the zombie minis. Buy it for parts, to practice painting, or to expand your Toxic City Mall experience!

Also, if you're interested, I do have the entire 1st Edition of A Game of Thrones: The Card Game on sale as well. I currently have it in binders for $75 but I could be willing to drop the price some more if you're okay with me putting the cards in a BCW white cardboard card box instead.

Sent you a geek mail.
[q="swimmingscorpion"]What's your preferred method of payment and is picking it up at the VFM good for you or do you need alternative arrangements? [/q]
Wow. Been thinking about getting into this LCG, and this gives me serious you snooze you lose-itis.
Oh my goodness. This is my #1 game. This is the best deal anyone could ever find. Enjoy!

Yeah, unfortunately I found out yesterday that what's in my collection and the new Return of the King Saga Expansion is all that they're putting out new versions of and that all the older card sets that are out of print aren't ever going to be reprinted so since I'll never have a truly "complete" collection I decided to toss it. I probably should have asked for more for it since I spent over $400 on it when I bought it six months ago but I was just so mad about the product line being cut off like that, especially when I did the additional research and found out that it was planned to only do 3/9 existing campaigns, and 3/4 sagas with no actually new content being developed way back when they decided to do the Revised Core Set.

Item: Dark Tower Condition: New Open Box...yes, really! Read below for details. Price: $275
+remove+ sales closed to prepare for the convention
Description What a rare unicorn this is! This is the original Dark Tower board game, 100% complete, with sealed components inside an open box. You read that right, a game from 1981 that has remained untouched / unplayed for decades. Because everything is sealed, the tower has not been tested, so please take that into account before deciding to buy. The box - as you would expect - is rough. The box was a stupid design anyway...the lid was not designed to fit snug, and there was a special cardboard insert (missing here) that kept the lid higher so it would be square. All four corner of the box lid have been repaired / reinforced with clear tape.
Inside the box are several still sealed plastic bags with components. Yes, that includes the replacement light bulb for the tower. 🙂 The manual somehow got bent in the bag - the edge with the spine is curled up.
I don't currently have pictures but am happy to take some and either send them to an email you provide or post them here as part of the listing.
Exchange notes: :arrowE: I will be attending BGG Fall. If I do not qualify for a seller table I will be flexible as to when to meet for an exchange. :arrowE: I am an experienced eBay seller and will happily ship games at buyer's expense. :arrowE: I accept PayPal Friends and Family once you have had the opportunity to inspect your purchase. I also accept Venmo or Cash. :arrowE: I use [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/wiki/page/Condition_of_a_game]this article[/url] for determining the condition of the items I have for sale.
Paperback copy of [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/195120400X?tag=vulearboorev-20]A Programmer's Guide to Computer Science[/url], new, signed if desired (I am the author). $20

2011 Hasbro English edition. Complete with box, components, and miniature spaceships all in great condition.
Hits on ships are shown with pegs. That's about the only similarity between this space combat game about the epic conflict between the Intergalactic Space Navy and the alien Wretcheridians and classic Battleship. There's twenty surprisingly high quality miniature fleet and alien ships, an open space board, and ship cards with stats and damage allocation. It's a Hasbro game, but the design team wore a lot of Plaid Hats 🙂
[b]Mechanics: [/b]Action Points, Area Movements, Critical Hits, Variable Player Powers

Take a look at my list...I have others I could probably offer if none of those appeal to you and you're open to trade.[/q] Hi, Courtney, thanks for the interest! For the most part I am trying to downsize my collection this year. The only things I might look at in trade would be games that are out of print fantasy or sci-fi themed games. So...if you have something in that area, hit me up. Obviously something like that would be worth more than my $35 asking price here but that's fine, I can pay cash or offer additional games I might be selling in trade as well.

item.comment:
[q="Anakinnnn"]I'll offer $60 for this bundle.[/q] Hey, Jason, I appreciate the offer! I think I will stay with my $75 asking price. Both the game and the expansion are still in shrink, and the base game typically sells (on average) for about $50 when it's available but it's out of stock most places at the moment. The expansion is available, but typically priced about $25. So $75 seems like a fair price. I will likely keep it in my collection if it doesn't sell at my ask, and probably be sad if it does sell, so there's that. :)
So while I do appreciate the offer, I will pass. Thanks!
Dave, I'll take both of these off your hands for your asking price of $75
[q="sumobiznaz"]Dave, I'll take both of these off your hands for your asking price of $75[/q] Excellent, will see you at the VFM!

Open, in good condition but MISSING PARTS. See below.
All of the board and tokens are present and in great condition. However, one metal bearing is missing (there should be one per player) and the original die is missing. The game die is not a regular d6 but instead has 1,2,2,3,3,4 on the sides. I added a foam die with those numbers, and we just always played it with 2 or 3 players and it worked great. So it's very playable (and fun!) but not complete.
Price - maybe like some Reese's Pieces and a Dr Pepper? I dunno, make me an offer!
Sold or whatever to [user=david546] (to be figured out via Geekmail)

item.comment: Is this the version with the text on the tiles? If so, I'll take it
Yes, it is the newer version pictured above with text on the building tiles. SOLD!
This did not have the text on the tiles as promised

I also own this 1897 version. Technically there is text on the tiles: the name of the building and it's numerical value. The 1897 edition of the game, as I understand, only has one version of the tiles which never included a full description of the building actions on them.
Even though the mechanisms are the same as the original game, Puerto Rico 1897 has a seperate Geeklisting from the older versions of the game. The older version of the game is the version that has additional descriptive text on the tiles with the older artwork. It would have appeared just as "Puerto Rico" in this list not "Puerto Rico 1897".
It appears that within the photo section on the geeklisting of "Puerto Rico 1897" there are fan-modified cards that include the text describing the building actions, but these appear to be stickers or home-printed and pasted text. I don't know if these were the tiles you were referring to when you asked about "text on tiles"?

There was an updated printed that was released Q4 '23 or Q1 '24. It has text on the tiles with a short description. Also when I picked it up I was told he messaged the company and got replacement tiles.
https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/1/blogpost/148831/a-second-update-from-ravensburger-on-puerto-rico-1

What version is this? Factory Funner&Bigger ‐ EN/FR/GE/NL second edition (2018) Cwali Factory Funner&Bigger ‐ EN/FR/GE/NL second edition (2019) Cwali or is it one of: Factory Funner ‐ EN/FR/GE/NL first edition (2016) Cwali Factory Funner ‐ BoardGameTables English edition (2022) BoardGameTables

Also, is the game new in shrink? Or has it been played?

Howdy, Sterling & Winkles!
This is the Cwali Factory Funner & Bigger from the 2018 KS The box is 3" (76.2 mm). Box is opened and punched from a single play. All components are bagged. Silica gel pack included for free.

That was what I was looking for (larger box to fit the pieces better), but I have the smaller box in shrink-wrap (which my allergy prone wife requires.) I think I am going to leave this available for someone else to purchase it from you. My apologies for causing you to get more information! (Honestly, trying to figure out the editions of this game is confusing!) I will check back later if no one else grabs this great deal!

item.objectname: The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game – Revised Core Set
item.body:
[b]Not for the core set.[/b]
[-]$90.[/-] $70
This is for roughly 130 alt-art player cards, printed by MB Print (a Polish printer) on official backs. The cards can be found here. All cards have three copies, though some with multiple artwork have one of each (instead of three of each or three of the same). It includes all of the ones that didn't follow the "standard" format of LOTR cards. For example, included are three copies of the Balrog version of "A Test of Will" (6) which has the Event in the top right of the text instead of the bottom middle.
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1C-DBxestRDQBTQwmj_KxtTikog4os8xq?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAR0m6nudSaqtGwbAfVtHhUCo6Fj-VvNuKg9btMN5ivsE0XJEHcan5a_fy54_aem_DSGE-oFUJbzk_PfXpqayrg
They are essentially a "best cards not re-released, though with alternate artwork" set.
Also included is an alt art set of every hero published for the game, also printed on official art backs. You can see the hero cards there. A nice way to expand your heroes if you don't want to pick up all of the original material.
Originally ordered here as part of a group order: https://sklep.mbprint.pl/en/product/lotr-group-order-by-doug-beer/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAR2eZqK-sY6AcAUHACutmKlGYehFa5PQ_O1RaXnvOlcUflTmVLnKkFozVWs_aem_Pu-kAvtI9sKdqflvGQVfXA
I picked these up as I liked having all of the cards for deck building and something different to look at, and didn't want to spend $2,000 on a complete set. 🙂

item.body:
[B]Version:[/B] [B]Language:[/B] [B]Condition:[/B] New -[-] [I]This is an auction for a Crokinole board handmade by me, a semiretired woodworker. I am finishing up 2 boards one of which I will be selling. Highest bid will decide which of the two boards they want.
I will be adding pictures and more information at each day until the close of the auction some time Sunday evening. Feel free to ask any questions you might have.
[imageid=8520730]Board #1: The playing surface is wormy maple, the gutter is baltic birch and the rail is hard maple. I have resawn the wormy maple and bookmatched in pairs to get this look.
